headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: Revenue rose across the major players, with TCS reporting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech posted a 3% QoQ revenue increase and highlighted AI sales as a growth driver. Tech Mahindra and Infosys also showed double‑digit YoY growth. Persistent recorded a revenue jump but profit fell due to acquisition costs.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech emphasized AI revenue contributions, with HCLTech noting a 78% YoY AI revenue jump.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier firms
themes.detail: Persistent's profit declined despite revenue growth, reflecting higher integration costs.
